name: reconcile_exit_advisory_db_bar_fallback_lq1777_20261110
comment: LQ-1777: an n8n lane child runs env-scrubbed with no broker credentials, so the live bar transport returns nothing datable and every due pair became bars_unavailable -> exit 1 dependency_unavailable. The exit-advisory reconciler now falls back to the dated daily closes in ticker_prices before declaring the source unavailable; when the store also has no dated close the LQ-1706 bars_unavailable contract is preserved, and a store series that starts after the advisory stays NOT_EVALUABLE.
